times.note: Times are calculated for your city. Follow your local mosque if it differs.
times.unknown: Add your city in household settings to see suhoor and iftar times.

log.title: Log a fast
log.intermittentNote: Intermittent fasting is for adults only and is not offered in pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
log.reasonPrivate: Private: only this person (or the account owner for a child) can see the reason.

error.not_allowed: Fasts can't be logged for this person.
error.kind_not_allowed: This kind of fast isn't available for this person.
error.too_far_ahead: You can log up to one day ahead.
error.exemption_reason_required: Choose a reason, or pick another outcome.

ramadan.title: Ramadan {{year}}
ramadan.legend: Filled: fasted. Outlined: practice. Grey: not fasted or exempt.

qada.fidya: For a lasting reason, fidya (feeding someone in need for each day) may apply instead of making up. Ask a scholar you trust.
qada.scholar: A guide only. For your own situation, ask a scholar you trust.

practice.label: Practice
practice.weekend_full: A full day at the weekend

disclaimer: Thuluth offers general guidance, not a fatwa or medical advice. If you feel unwell while fasting, break the fast.

safety.title: {{name}} should not fast without a clinician
safety.body: Fasting with this health condition can be dangerous. Please decide together with a doctor before fasting.

reason.insulin_or_sulfonylurea: Takes insulin or a sulfonylurea: fasting can cause dangerously low blood sugar.
reason.eating_disorder_signals: Signs of a difficult relationship with food.

safety.footer: Islam exempts anyone whose health is at risk. There is no blame in not fasting.

child.under7Body: Children under 7 don't fast. Let them join suhoor and iftar with the family.
child.practiceBody: From 7, children can practise with part-day fasts, at their own pace.
child.stopRules: Stop the fast if they feel dizzy, very tired, unwell or upset. Praise the effort, never push.

pregnancy.title: Decide with a clinician
pregnancy.body: In pregnancy or while breastfeeding, fasting is a choice to make with your doctor. Not fasting is allowed.
